shots.name: 01-overview-desktop
shots.caption: Opening view: identity, totals, composition, derived entry points and the kind-by-kind grid — no artifact body, no artifact-level graph.

shots.name: 02-artifact-detail-desktop
shots.caption: One active artifact: grouped list with the selection’s kind open, linked metadata, and its neighbourhood beside the Reader.

shots.name: 03-relationship-groups-collapsed
shots.caption: The most connected artifact: groups derive exact counts and the large ones start collapsed.

shots.name: 04-relationship-groups-expanded
shots.caption: The same artifact with every group expanded: exactly the counted members appear.

shots.name: 05-artifact-detail-narrow
shots.caption: Narrow viewport: the detail is its own state, reached from the list.

shots.name: 06-artifact-list-narrow
shots.caption: Narrow viewport: the list is its own state, not a compressed desktop layout.

shots.name: 07-long-title-and-body
shots.caption: Long title and body wrap within their container; the page does not scroll sideways.

shots.name: 08-unknown-identifier
shots.caption: An identifier this snapshot does not contain is named, with a way onward.

shots.name: 10-focus-visible
shots.caption: Keyboard focus is visible: the focus ring on the selected list entry.

shots.name: 11-no-colour
shots.caption: Rendered without colour: kind, status, selection and relationship direction remain determinable.

shots.name: 12-search-ranked
shots.caption: Ranked search for "product" in the search dialog: the derived total and display limit are visible, identifier and title matches above body-only ones.

shots.name: 13-search-snippet
shots.caption: A body match shows a snippet of the matching content, inserted as text.

shots.name: 14-search-keyboard-active
shots.caption: Arrow keys move an active result, reported with aria-activedescendant; Enter follows it.

shots.name: 15-search-no-results
shots.caption: A query matching nothing says so, and repeats the query it searched for.

shots.name: 16-search-narrow
shots.caption: The search dialog on a narrow viewport.

shots.name: 17-focus-typical
shots.caption: Focused neighbourhood of a typical artifact: declared groups in rows above the anchor, referencing groups below.

shots.name: 18-focus-hardest
shots.caption: The hardest artifact in the model: one counted group per relationship type and kind, never one node per relationship.

shots.name: 19-focus-expanded
shots.caption: One group opened: its members listed beside it, its Reader counterpart opened and in view.

shots.name: 20-focus-isolated
shots.caption: An artifact with no relationships says so rather than drawing an empty diagram.

shots.name: 21-overview-dark
shots.caption: The dark appearance, chosen in the address: every colour from its own token set.

shots.name: 22-artifact-dark
shots.caption: The Reader and neighbourhood in the dark appearance.

shots.name: 23-master-rail
shots.caption: The master area collapsed to its kind rail: the selected kind stays marked while the Reader takes the room.

shots.name: 24-search-narrowed
shots.caption: Search narrowed to one kind where the query is typed; the same narrowing is named beside the list.

shots.name: 25-shortcuts
shots.caption: Every shortcut is stated on the page, and each has a visible control.
